about: Dimensional Rift levels whose boss players have reported, season 1. The game data behind rift-levels.json carries recommended power only; bosses come from posts, videos and one calculator screenshot. Each level is one boss fight, with adds from both sides. Players describe the bosses cycling every five levels (Cake Hound Pack, Cool Mint, Werehound Princess, truck, GingerCraven; dc:80225, dc:80294 comments); every screenshot level fits it, and 롤로노아's level-23 truck (nv:48662) is the one report that doesn't, so it isn't listed.
